mods.abstract: "Prepared by Chas. A. Drefs, Apothecary." 2 fluid ounce bottle containing worm syrup for children and adults to treat round, thread, or pin worms; includes instructions in English and German; on the back of the box is an advertisement for Drefs' Gout and Rheumatic Pills.
